messages:
Diego R.: Heads-up: redwoodctl v0.9.x auto-update hangs for lots of people behind corporate proxies. It tries to reach updates.redwood.ai and just times out. No graceful timeout message, just spinner.

Hannah S.: I hit that too. Our proxy requires PAC auth and the binary doesn't respect HTTP_PROXY for the updater. `redwoodctl update` should honor env vars IMHO.

Marta V.: Repro: set `HTTP_PROXY` to our proxy, run `redwoodctl update --check`. Process still attempts direct TLS and fails after 60s. Workaround: manually download the binary and `chmod +x` into /usr/local/bin.

Diego R.: Also noticed update writes a plain-text backup of the old binary to `~/.redwood/updates/old` with owner readable perms. That directory can contain tokens if someone previously misconfigured redwoodctl to write creds to that folder (side-effect of old installer). Probably a security concern.

Hannah S.: Can we change the updater to respect `HTTP_PROXY`/`HTTPS_PROXY`, reduce default network timeout to ~8s, and avoid writing credentials into update directories? I'll open a docs+bug.

CI-bot: flakey: pipeline #4456 failed due to redwoodctl auth error while running `redwoodctl login --profile ci-runner`. Error: "failed to open browser".

Marta V.: CI tip: `redwoodctl login --token-file /secrets/redwood_token --profile ci-runner` works, but not documented. Also the token-file path must be world-readable by the job user else redwoodctl errors obscurely.

Diego R.: Suggest default config file permissions be 0600 and an explicit error if token file is unreadable. Also add `--proxy` flag for the updater and `--no-update` to skip auto-check in constrained environments.

Hannah S.: Filed issue #2450: "updater: respect proxy env vars, shrink timeouts, avoid leaking artifacts; improve token-file docs" with minimal repro and suggested fix.

redwoodctl-bot: New issue created: #2450 "updater: proxy handling and update artifacts leak" by Hannah S. https://github.com/redwood/repo/issues/2450

Marta V.: One UX idea: during `redwoodctl init` prompt for whether the host is behind a proxy and write proxy settings to config (but not tokens). That would help onboarding for enterprise users.

Diego R.: +1. Also add a short troubleshooting section: "If update hangs, try `HTTP_PROXY='' redwoodctl update --no-check` and then manual install".

Hannah S.: I'll add docs PR and include the token-file example and perms note. Diego can take the updater patch.

Diego R.: On it. Thanks everyone.
